methods.what: Factorization of a quotient of theta functions with arguments sums of Abelian integrals (over m points u and m points alpha) into a product of a function of the z's and a function of the zeta's
Expression of the square of chi as a ratio of a sum of m-th order theta derivatives times differentials of the alpha-integrals to products of sums of first theta derivatives times differentials

items.english: The theta quotient equals chi(z_1,...,z_m) times chi(zeta_1,...,zeta_m).
